sn46.39:1.3: _Kacchaka_ is found here, where it is described as a parasitic strangler, which agrees with [pli-tv-bu-vb-pc11:2.1.6](), where it is said to propagate from the trunk. It is sometimes identified with *Toona ciliata*, the red cedar, but that cannot be correct, as it is not a strangler. I translate as “Moreton bay fig” in homage to the magnificent trees of Sydney.
